title: Lemony Leek Lentils with Halloumi
description: Green lentils simmered with leek, garlic, tomato purée, mustard and lemon juice, finished with wilted spinach and topped with pan-fried halloumi.
ingredients: 1 leek, trimmed, cleaned and very finely chopped
2 × 400g cans green lentils, drained and rinsed
2 large handfuls baby spinach, roughly chopped
steps: Fry leek and garlic gently in cooking spray for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, stock, tomato purée, mustard, thyme and lemon juice; season; simmer 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, fry halloumi in a hot nonstick pan (no cooking spray) for about 2 minutes per side until golden. Set aside.
After 12 minutes, stir spinach through to wilt for 1 minute.
Serve lentils topped with halloumi and scattered with parsley.
notes: Also works with fried chicken or salmon instead of halloumi, or roasted sweet potato cubes.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
